description: Entries of the vault (passwords, API keys, tokens, notes) this tunnel may use: its own and the whole account's, with name, description, kind, service, status and expiry. Never the values: read one with vault_get. Live entries come first. status is "zywy" (live) or "martwy" (dead: revoked or replaced by a newer key); expired is true once expires_at has passed. Pick an entry that is live and not expired. Only the agent on duty in the tunnel (the cable that holds the lease) reads the vault.
name: vault_list
